questions.stem_text:
If current real GDP is $5000 and full employment real GDP is at $4000 which of the
following combinations of policies is the most likely to have brought the economy to this
point?

options.A: A decrease in taxes and buying bonds in an open market operation
options.B: An increase in government spending and an increase in taxes
options.C: An increase in taxes and selling bonds in an open market operation
options.D: An increase in taxes and a lower discount rate
options.E: A decrease in taxes and selling bonds in an open market operation

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: A - A decrease in taxes and buying bonds in an open market operation

questions.stem_text: Which of the following is correct?

options.A: In the long run, demand cannot adjust fully to changes in supply.
options.B: In the long run, supply is not able to adjust fully to changes in demand.
options.C: In the long run, all inputs are fixed.
options.D: In the short run, supply is able to adjust fully to changes in demand.
options.E: In the short run, demand is able to adjust fully to changes in supply.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: A - In the long run, demand cannot adjust fully to changes in supply.

questions.stem_text: Why is it difficult sometimes to definemonopolistically competitive industries?

options.A: Product differentiation and loss of perfect substitutability
options.B: Barriers to entry and exit in the market
options.C: High consumer loyalty to a single brand
options.E: Constant production costs regardless of output levels

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: A - Product differentiation and loss of perfect substitutability

questions.stem_text: The appropriate fiscal policy to remedy inflation calls for

options.A: decreased government spending and increased taxes.
options.B: the federal government to decrease the money supply.
options.C: the federal government to run a deficit.
options.D: decreased taxes and increased government spending.
options.E: the federal government to increase the money supply.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: A - decreased government spending and increased taxes.
